## What changed and why

Describe the user-visible outcome and relevant decisions.

## Verification

List actual commands/observations and results. State what was not exercised. A build is not an end-to-end test.

## Documentation and compatibility

Note API/tool/schema changes, affected docs, client compatibility and upstream notices where applicable.

## Operations and remaining limits

State deployment/migration effects, data or credential preservation, rollback limits and remaining work. Omit sections that do not apply.
